claim: COVID-19 had caused zero deaths in people under 20.

sub_claims.question: As of July 10, 2020, were there any confirmed deaths from COVID-19 in individuals aged 0-19?
sub_claims.answer: Yes, based on my knowledge, health authorities like the CDC and WHO had reported deaths in children and adolescents from COVID-19 before that date.

evidence.statement: The U.S. Centers for Disease Control and Prevention (CDC) reported confirmed COVID-19 deaths in individuals aged 0-19 in the United States in its data updates as of June 2020, which was before July 10, 2020.

sub_claims.question: Did global or national health agencies document COVID-19-related deaths in people under 20 by mid-2020?
sub_claims.answer: Yes, agencies such as the CDC and WHO acknowledged deaths in young age groups in their data and reports prior to July 2020.

evidence.statement: The World Health Organization (WHO) included deaths in the age group under 20 in its COVID-19 situation reports published in June 2020.
The CDC's COVID-19 surveillance data documented deaths in children and adolescents (under 20) by mid-2020.
